summary: Frontend-only iteration-2 testing for the Wehive revised fee structure (+applicants stepper), landmark images on country grid, AI flight suggestions module, and Framer Motion page transitions. All major test cases passed end-to-end against the public preview URL. Backend retests not run in this iteration (frontend-only request, prior round 14/16 + main agent confirms 28/28 locally).

issues: The alphabetical country grid renders 182 entries; popular countries US, UK/GB, FR, JP, AE, TH appear only as 'Most requested' chips at the top (rendered as buttons, not <a>). Landmark images therefore do not surface on the main grid for those most-popular countries. Landmarks ARE applied correctly for 39 other countries that DO appear in the grid (AR, AU, AT, BE, BR, CZ, DK, EG, ES, FI, IN, IT, MX, NZ, PE, etc.). Consider also rendering landmark thumbnails inside the 'Most requested this week' chip row for visual consistency.

verified_test_cases: /visa/us fee breakdown: govt ₹15,400 + base ₹3,500 + appointment ₹1,750 + GST ₹945 = total ₹21,595 (matches spec exactly). NO 'Hive fee' line. Apply CTA shows 'Apply · ₹21,595'.
Applicants stepper +2 → fee-row-extra shows '2 × ₹350 = ₹700'; applicants-count = 3; new total ₹22,421 (= 21,595 + 700 base + 126 GST on extra). Math correct.
applicants-decrement is_disabled === True when count===1 (verified via Playwright is_disabled()).
/visa/ae: appointment row absent (UAE requires_appointment=false), total ₹10,830 (govt ₹6,700 + base ₹3,500 + GST ₹630).
/visa/np (Nepal, visa-free): fee-breakdown-free card visible with 'No fees apply.' headline; hero Apply CTA reads 'Continue · Free'.

/visa/us flight-suggestions section renders 3 cards: flight-card-us-1 = Air India CHEAPEST ₹64,500 BLR→JFK; flight-card-us-2 = Emirates MOST POPULAR ₹78,900; flight-card-us-3 = United FASTEST ₹92,500 BLR→EWR. flight-search-cta link to Skyscanner present.
Hero search 'ind' → hero-search-popover shows British Indian Ocean Territory + India + Indonesia (matches expected backend search).

Country-grid landmarks: 39 cards on home grid render Unsplash landmark photos (verified: IN→Taj Mahal, SG→Marina Bay, AR→Buenos Aires, AU→Sydney, AT→Vienna, BE→Brussels, BR→Christ the Redeemer all match expected image IDs from /app/frontend/src/lib/landmarks.js).
Page transition wrapper present in App.js via AnimatePresence + PageTransition (variants opacity/y, 350ms ease). Navigation / → /visa/us completes successfully with no console errors.
No console errors captured during full test run (only the pre-existing nested <a> hydration warning noted in iter-1 — non-blocking).
not_retested_in_this_iteration: Backend pytest /app/backend/tests/test_wehive_backend.py (frontend-only request; main agent reports 28/28 locally).

Login OTP flow + AI Scan with AI button: already verified in iteration 1; selectors unchanged. Login form on /login page expects user to use the AuthModal opened from Sign in/Sign up buttons (separate route inputs not directly fillable).
action_items: (Minor / nice-to-have) Surface landmark images on the 'Most requested this week' chip strip for US/UK/FR/JP/AE/TH so the marquee popular countries also benefit from the landmark catalogue. Currently they're chip-buttons without imagery.
(Carry-over from iter-1, NOT re-tested here) Wrap LlmChat.send_message in routes_scan._call_gemini_vision with try/except to translate ChatError into a 502/503 with user-friendly detail.
(Carry-over from iter-1) Resolve nested <a> hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: FeeBreakdown.computeFees: 'isVisaFree' detection relies on category.name containing 'visa-free' AND govt===0. Works for current seed but is fragile — recommend a canonical boolean flag on the category (e.g., category.visa_free or country.visa_free === true) to avoid breakage when copy is localized.

FlightSuggestions: stub dataset is hard-coded by ISO-2 keys; component returns null for any country not in STUBS (no empty-state UI shown to user). This is acceptable since the section just disappears, but consider a 'Live API coming soon' card for non-stubbed destinations once the backend route lands.

VisaDetail.jsx: applicants state lives in VisaDetail AND inside FeeBreakdown (two sources of truth — local useState in FeeBreakdown is the real one, VisaDetail mirrors via onApplicantsChange). Consider lifting the state fully into VisaDetail to keep CategoryDetails fees and FeeBreakdown fees in lockstep (today CategoryDetails computes via computeFees with the parent applicants prop while FeeBreakdown computes with its own state — they happen to match because of the callback, but a missed callback would drift).
landmarks.js: keys 'uk' and 'gb' are duplicated to handle both id schemes. Acceptable but creates a bug surface if one is updated without the other — extract a constant.
PageTransition: exit animation duration (0.35s) is added to every navigation. Consider lowering to 0.18-0.22s or using mode='popLayout' to make navigation feel snappier on slower devices.

success_rate.backend: not retested this iteration (28/28 locally per main agent)
success_rate.frontend: 100% on the iteration-2 spec (all 13 listed test cases pass)
